changes.new_text: We are increasingly dependent on third-party providers of specialized AI accelerators and data center capacity. Supply constraints, export restrictions, or price increases affecting these components could delay the expansion of our cloud services and increase our operating costs.

New and evolving regulations governing artificial intelligence, including obligations related to transparency, risk assessment and model governance, could require significant changes to our products and expose us to fines or litigation if we fail to comply.

A material portion of our revenue now derives from multi-year commitments by large enterprise customers. The loss or non-renewal of one or more of these commitments could adversely affect our results of operations.

changes.old_text: Our international operations subject us to risks from changes in foreign currency exchange rates, which could reduce our reported revenue and operating income.
changes.new_text: Our international operations subject us to significant risks from changes in foreign currency exchange rates and capital controls, which could materially reduce our reported revenue, operating income and cash flows.

changes.old_text: Cyberattacks and security vulnerabilities could lead to reduced revenue, increased costs, liability claims, or harm to our reputation.
changes.new_text: Cyberattacks, including attacks by nation-state actors and attacks that use generative AI tools, and security vulnerabilities could lead to reduced revenue, increased costs, regulatory penalties, liability claims, or harm to our reputation.

changes.old_text: We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins.
changes.new_text: We face intense and rapidly evolving competition across all markets for our products and services, including from new entrants offering AI-based alternatives, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins.

changes.old_text: Our hardware products depend on a limited number of contract manufacturers located primarily in Asia.
changes.new_text: Our hardware and devices depend on a limited number of contract manufacturers, some of which are located in regions affected by geopolitical tension and trade restrictions.

changes.old_text: The transition of our workforce to hybrid working arrangements may disrupt our operations and make it more difficult to retain key employees.

ask.answer: Şirket, en son 10-K raporunda özel yapay zekâ hızlandırıcıları ve veri merkezi kapasitesi sağlayan üçüncü taraflara bağımlılığının arttığını yeni bir risk olarak eklemiştir; tedarik kısıtları veya ihracat kısıtlamaları bulut hizmetlerinin genişlemesini geciktirebilir [1]. Önceki yıl donanım üretimi yalnızca Asya'daki sözleşmeli üreticilerle ilişkilendirilirken, yeni metinde jeopolitik gerilim ve ticaret kısıtlamalarından etkilenen bölgeler açıkça belirtilmektedir [2].

sources.text: We are increasingly dependent on third-party providers of specialized AI accelerators and data center capacity. Supply constraints, export restrictions, or price increases affecting these components could delay the expansion of our cloud services and increase our operating costs.
Our hardware and devices depend on a limited number of contract manufacturers, some of which are located in regions affected by geopolitical tension and trade restrictions.

ask.answer: Yönetimin değerlendirmesine göre gelir, bulut platformuna yönelik güçlü talep sayesinde %15 artarak 258,6 milyar dolara ulaşmıştır [1]. Faaliyet kârı ise gelir büyümesi ve maliyet disiplini sayesinde %18 artmıştır; ancak yapay zekâ altyapısına yönelik yatırım harcamalarının belirgin biçimde arttığı da belirtilmektedir [2].

sources.text: Revenue increased 15% to $258.6 billion, driven by strong demand for our cloud platform.
Capital expenditures increased significantly to support demand for AI infrastructure, reducing free cash flow growth.
